newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA WINS ORDER FROM PHILIPPINE GLOBE.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA WINS ORDER FROM PHILIPPINE GLOBE.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said on Wednesday it had been selected to supply a wireless solution for a fixed telephone project built by Globe Telecom of the Philippines in southern Luzon.
Nokia did not give the value of the order.

"Nokia will supply infrastructure equipment and ... wireless local loop (WLL) subscriber terminals for the initial phase of WLL technology trial applications in parts of Globe Telecom service areas," it said.
Globe Telecom was currently building a fully digital fixed telephone infrastructure making use of both fixed and wireless technologies.
"The use of WLL is expected to greatly accelerate the roll-out in areas where the use of wireless technology instead of copper cables would lead to faster line deployment," it said.
Globe Telecom is a venture between Ayala Corporation and Singapore Telecom International.
